Title: Retirement: HBv2-series Azure Virtual Machines will be retired on May 31, 2027
Summary: On May 31, 2027, Microsoft Azure will retire the following HBv2-series virtual machine (VMs) sizes: Standard_HB120rs_v2, Standard_HB120-96rs_v2, Standard_HB120-64rs_v2, Standard_HB120-32rs_v2, and Standard_HB120-16rs_v2.  To ensure continuity and improved
